purpose: Example: judge a Cells run of the BETSE default world (headless_core, every INIT and SIM step sampled) against the plain-BETSE case betse-reference-20261108-01/default-world-dense. Fix this file before the Cells run it judges; that run must record this file's sha256 in its comparison manifest.
notes: codata_constants: Cells with CODATA F and R against BETSE's rounded F = 96485, R = 8.314. matched_constants_or_cpu_gpu: Cells with BETSE's constants, or Cells CPU against GPU.
Relative errors divide by |BETSE value|; a zero reference value admits only exact agreement.
Default-world SIM Vmem changes by about 3 uV over the phase, below the 10 uV codata voltage tolerance; the comparator reports such observables as flat.
